M6.5c fire support: Battalion 120 mm mortars (Moerser 120 mm): game values for the time to first round, spread and cadence. Pulled forward from M8 by the owner (M6 review); low confidence. Step fire-support (owner 2026-11-13, Firefight S11): two ranging rounds land first (first one off by the aiming error, each seen fall cuts the error to 30 %), 20 s apart, then the 4-tube battery fires for effect in volleys (rounds 0.6 s apart, volleys every intervalSeconds); delaySeconds is now the time to the first ranging round (was 90/75 s to the first round); a mission within 100 m of a point already ranged on skips ranging. All game values, no public source (search extracts only): low. M8.1 smoke v2: a smoke round's cloud rises to smokeTopM 15 m and its burning filling feeds the plume at its place for smokeBurnSeconds (red phosphorus / HC fillings burn for a minute or more; game values, low, owner to review). M8.2a call-for-fire chain (game values, low, owner to review): of delaySeconds the radio call takes requestSeconds 15 and the flight flightSeconds (16 s: a section about 2 km back), the rest is computing and laying; splash is called 5 s before a round lands; rangingErrorM is now the battery's own first-round error (15 m per axis, meteorology and survey) and the target's location adds 5 m + 7 % of the caller's range for a map or eye estimate (eye range estimates err 10-20 %), 2 m + 0.5 % with a laser rangefinder (so at 500 m an estimate misses about 3x as far); a registered or planned point keeps what was left after its adjustment.
